1.consolidated_definition: Compuesto medicinal campesino a base de aceite, gas (kerosén), ceboflande y azúcar. Se emplea para sanar heridas y golpes.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Rural medicinal compound made from oil, gas (kerosene), ceboflande, and sugar. It is used to heal wounds and bruises.
